---
title: "Simulations"
---

Two complementary simulation studies compare aerial platforms and survey designs for moose population monitoring in Alberta's boreal forest.

## [Optimizing Wildlife Survey Design: Simulating Drone and Helicopter Surveys for Moose](sim_multiplatform.qmd)

Fixed-wing drones, quadcopters, and conventional helicopters are compared across five Wildlife Management Units using line-transect distance sampling, testing how platform, camera configuration, and transect design affect accuracy and efficiency.

**Authors**: Leonard Hambrecht, Nicholas C. Coops, Gordon Stenhouse

## [When Is a Quadcopter the Right Tool for Wildlife Surveys?](sim_quadcopter.qmd)

A systematic evaluation of five quadcopter survey designs across ten wildlife density levels, identifying the density thresholds and flight designs needed for reliable population estimates.

**Authors**: Leonard Hambrecht, Nicholas C. Coops, Gordon Stenhouse, Philip DeWitt, Jason Airst
